# Original LEZAC.EXE live sprite-descriptor table, read from a running
# level-1 session in one /proc/mem pread (no breakpoints, no writes; the
# game had run >= 5 ticks past level start so load-time tables were final).
#
# Table: DS:0xC322, 92 entries, stride 4: { width:u8, height:u8,
# pixel_offset:u16le }. Entry 0 is the zeroed reserved slot -- the same
# one-based convention as the actor (0x74A8), motion-link (0x79EA) and boss
# (0x1BAE) tables. Entries 1..91 describe BOMOMIMK.SPR's 91 sprites with
# entry k mapping to FILE sprite k-1: dimensions match 91/91 and
# pixel_offset is the cumulative w*h sum, totalling exactly the file's
# 19985 payload bytes.
#
# This settles, at runtime, that DGROUP sprite-frame values are ONE-BASED
# over the SPR bank -- the -1 the port applies to every table-derived
# sprite range (previously inferred from dimensional coherence only).
sprite_descriptor_original=level1
source=LEZAC.EXE via DOSBox /proc/mem runtime read
runtime_ds=0c8f
descriptor_table_offset=0xc322
descriptor_stride=4
descriptor_entries=92
entry0_reserved=1
index_base=1
sprite_file=BOMOMIMK.SPR
file_sprites=91
file_payload_bytes=19985
descriptors_
visual_claim=0
temp_copy=1
